scripts.start:backend: concurrently "cd UserManagement/backend && npm start" "cd Bookings/backend && npm start" "cd RouteScheduling/backend && npm start" "cd SupplierManagement/backend && npm start"
scripts.start:frontend: concurrently "cd UserManagement/frontend && npm start" "cd Bookings/frontend && npm start" "cd RouteScheduling/frontend && npm start" "cd SupplierManagement/frontend && npm start" "cd FinancialManagement/app && npm run dev"
scripts.start:all: npm run start:backend & npm run start:frontend
scripts.install:all: concurrently "cd UserManagement/backend && npm install" "cd UserManagement/frontend && npm install" "cd Bookings/backend && npm install" "cd Bookings/frontend && npm install" "cd FinancialManagement/app && npm install" "cd RouteScheduling/backend && npm install" "cd RouteScheduling/frontend && npm install" "cd SupplierManagement/backend && npm install" "cd SupplierManagement/frontend && npm install"
